title: Asset ORB
description: A WebGL sphere built from 100 image planes distributed via a Fibonacci-sphere layout, each plane textured with a random editorial photo. Three.js OrbitControls let the user drag to rotate the orb and scroll to zoom, with damping/inertia for smooth momentum.

motion.title: Asset ORB
motion.motion_signature: damped orbit drag around textured photo sphere; OrbitControls inertia (dampingFactor 0.05, rotateSpeed 1.2, pan disabled, zoom clamped to distance 6–10) is the only physics, integrated inside one uncapped rAF loop
